task_meta.title: Make a wide orders table work on mobile

judge.reasons: Phone: tidy cards with order #, status, customer, total and date, labelled secondary details, sort control, stacked full-width controls. Desktop table keeps all columns, aligned numbers, sorted-column indicator. Status is coloured text, not badges.

claim_text: The Orders page now works on a 390px phone with no sideways scrolling, and desktop is still a normal table. I checked it in headless Edge at 320, 390, 768, 1024 and 1280px. The page and the table never scroll sideways at any of those widths, and no console errors or warnings appe
digest: Read 8 files (3 before its first edit), made 4 edits, ran tests 7 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
